name: literature-search
description: Search arXiv and Crossref for papers and read one paper's abstract by arXiv id or DOI. Both sources are public and need no credential.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search arXiv or Crossref. Returns a JSON array of {title, authors, published, id, abstract, url, source}; id is an arXiv id for arxiv and a DOI for crossref.

query.description: Free-text query. arxiv searches all fields; crossref uses its relevance ranking.

limit.description: Results to return. Above 20 the call fails with invalid_arguments instead of truncating.

items.title: string
items.published: string (ISO 8601; crossref may be YYYY-MM-01 when the record only states a year)
items.id: string (arXiv id with version suffix, or DOI)
items.abstract: string (empty when the source states none)

tools.name: get_abstract
tools.description: Read one paper by arXiv id or DOI. Returns {title, abstract, authors, published, url, license, source, id}. license is null when the source states none; null never means public domain.

id.description: arXiv id (1706.03762, hep-th/9901001, or an abs URL) or a DOI (10.1038/nature14539).

source.description: Optional. Defaults to the source implied by the id's shape.

output.title: string
output.abstract: string (empty when the source states none)
output.license: string | null (a URL when the source deposits one)
